speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did these symptoms appear suddenly over hours or days, or have they developed gradually over weeks? Also, have you experienced any recent headaches, vision changes, or difficulty speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Natalizumab use raises concern for progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML), so have you experienced any recent cognitive changes, memory loss, or personality changes alongside your ataxia? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain
